name: TRAINING ONLY - Investigation demand review
description: Fictional call-demand exercise: last 90 days, Investigation calls, dots coloured by call type. Review missing locations before drawing conclusions.
replay_steps: Open Map Visualizations; Library search Calls by type, choose the matching template and Customize.
Inspect Last90days and unselected day/hour buttons. Open Call types, select Investigation, then close the selector.
Review totals, location completeness and legend. Inspect Calls/Dots/Call type/Count layer choices.
Save as new; use the retained fictional name/description, leave Share with whole department unchecked and Save once.
Library: confirm saved name/description/Only visible to you. Reopen the saved view in a new page and inspect retained date/filter/display settings.
Read the saved map legend, completeness and time/type summaries. New recording dates, IDs and counts may differ.
side_effects: One private saved visualization created through normal UI. No call, status, location, sharing, deletion or notification operation executed.
scope_limits: No CSV download, copied-link delivery, response-time result, coverage/routing guarantee, additional layer or shared-department visibility test.
